name: devstack-mcp
description: Remote MCP connector for DevStack API — one keyless, normalized view of the whole developer registry across npm, PyPI, Docker Hub, and the VS Code Marketplace (search, package details, versions, download/pull stats) plus resolved dependency graphs (deps.dev), per-version vulnerabilities (OSV.dev), OSSF Scorecard insights, and cross-registry lookups over 50+ ecosystems (ecosyste.ms) — exposed as MCP tools for Claude/ChatGPT/any MCP client. The wrapped data is public developer-registry metadata with zero per-user state.
